title: Run Mein Aakar Sakina Pukari
body:
Run mein aakar Sakina pukari
Ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoon
Bane Qasim bahen tum pah vaari
Ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisi shaadi qayamat yeh aayi
Huvi dulha dulhan mein judaai
Nekh apna mein lene na paayi
Ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai kya jald ghar se sidhaare
Rasm poore huve na hamare
Muntezar hae baraati tumhare
Ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Joda shaadi ka tunh mein naya hae
So woh zaqmon se purze hua hae
Khoon sab dasto pa mein laga hae
Ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Bun mein shadi ki rangeen qaba hae
Sar pah phoolon ka sehra bandha hae
Chand sa moonh lahu mein bhara hae
Ghar chalo bhai mehndi lagaoon
